name: klipt-hero
prompt: Instagram post for Klipt, a French content studio that creates social videos and posts for businesses. Bold editorial typographic poster on a deep ink-blue background with subtle film grain. Huge white sans-serif headline, exactly: "Vos vidéos. Vos posts. En 24 h." Below, smaller: "Le studio de contenu des marques qui bougent." A floating smartphone at an angle shows a vibrant short video frame (a chef plating a dish). Small wordmark "klipt" in lowercase bottom left, electric lime accent line. Clean grid, generous margins, premium agency design, sharp legible text, no other text.

name: klipt-promo
prompt: Instagram promo post for Klipt, a content studio for small businesses. Warm, bright, modern design: a real photo of a smiling bakery owner behind her counter holding a phone, natural morning light, shallow depth of field. Large bold text overlay in the top third, exactly: "1er mois offert". Under it, smaller: "Des Reels pro pour votre commerce". A lime rounded button at the bottom with the text "klipt.fr". Balanced composition, legible typography, authentic, not stock-looking, no other text.

name: klipt-carousel-cover
prompt: Cover slide of an educational Instagram carousel by Klipt, a content studio. Swiss-style typographic layout on an off-white paper background, strict grid, black text with one lime highlight. Giant headline, exactly: "3 erreurs qui tuent vos Reels". A big number "3" in lime cut by the grid. Bottom right, small text: "Glissez →". Tiny wordmark "klipt" top left. Minimal, editorial, sharp typography, no photos, no other text.
